results.name: GEO-86-TC001 — Progress is visible during analysis
steps: Given an Editor opens a report while analysis is running
When the progress view loads
Then the current progress and completed or pending model counts are shown

results.name: GEO-86-TC002 — Completion is reported as COMPLETED
steps: Given the analysis has finished successfully
When the final progress event is received
Then the status is COMPLETED

results.name: GEO-86-TC003 — Completion is reported as COMPLETED_PARTIAL
steps: Given the analysis ends with partial success
When the final progress event is received
Then the status is COMPLETED_PARTIAL

results.name: GEO-86-TC004 — Completion is reported as FAILED
steps: Given the analysis cannot complete
When the final progress event is received
Then the status is FAILED

results.name: GEO-86-TC005 — Reconnecting returns the current progress state
steps: Given the Editor loses the progress connection
When the Editor reconnects to the progress view
Then the current progress state is shown immediately

results.name: GEO-86-TC006 — AC6 Frontend Progress Display
steps: Given SSE events streaming to frontend
Then SseProgress component renders:
And Global progress bar (0-100%)
And Per-LLM list (icon + name + individual bar + status badge)
And Contextual message with current phase
And Status badges: PROCESSING (blue animated), COMPLETED (green), PARTIAL (orange), FAILED (red)
And Heartbeat pulse animation every 30s

results.name: GEO-86-TC007 — Progress view exposes accessible progress semantics
GEO-83-TC001 — Successful pipeline finalizes the report
steps: Given all analysis phases have completed successfully
When finalization runs
Then the report status is COMPLETED

results.name: GEO-83-TC002 — Partial pipeline finalizes the report as completed partial
steps: Given the pipeline finished with some non-blocking failures
When finalization runs
Then the report status is COMPLETED_PARTIAL

results.name: GEO-83-TC003 — Failed pipeline finalizes the report as failed
steps: Given the pipeline cannot complete
When finalization runs
Then the report status is FAILED

results.name: GEO-83-TC004 — AC3 Competitive Response Enrichment
steps: Then each competitive response is enriched with same fields as visibility (per 2-enrichissement.md section 2.4):
And target_rank (Integer, nullable) — brand's position
And is_mentioned (Boolean) — brand appears
And is_first (Boolean) — brand is #1
And total_entities (Integer) — total entities in ranking

results.name: GEO-83-TC005 — AC4 Source Extraction from All Responses
steps: When source extraction runs
Then all unique URLs are collected from ALL responses (visibility + perception + competitive) for this reportId + snapshotId
And no data from another organization is visible
And domain is normalized: lowercase, strip www., extract root domain (e.g., news.linkedin.com → linkedin.com), handle compound TLDs (co.uk, com.au)

results.name: GEO-83-TC006 — AC5 Source Classification — 3 Levels
steps: Given unique domains collected from all response sources
When classification runs
Then Level 1 (regex pre-classification, no AI):
And x.com / twitter.com → Social/UGC
And youtube.com → Social/UGC
And Sources from grok_x_search type → Social/UGC
And Brand's own domain → Owned Media
And Competitor's domain → Competitor Media
Then Level 2 (shared cache, cross-tenant):
And no data from another organization is visible
And Context provided: brand name, list of competitors, domains to classify
And Result saved to domain_classifications for future reports (cross-tenant cache)
And Regex fallback: .edu → Academic/Research, .gov → Government/NGO, otherwise → Other (confidence=low)

results.name: GEO-87-TC001 — First analysis starts automatically
steps: Given a report has just been submitted with status PENDING
When the analysis starts automatically
Then questions are dispatched to each enabled LLM

results.name: GEO-87-TC002 — Failed LLM response does not block execution
steps: Given an LLM request keeps failing for the current analysis
When the failure threshold is reached
Then the response is marked FAILED and the analysis continues

results.name: GEO-87-TC003 — One LLM pause does not stop the others
steps: Given one LLM has exceeded the error threshold
When the breaker opens for that LLM
Then only that LLM is paused and the other LLMs keep running

results.name: GEO-85-TC001 — Competitor placeholders are replaced with real names
steps: Given visibility analysis has identified competitors for a market and category
When the competitive questions are generated
Then the competitor placeholders are replaced with the discovered competitor names

results.name: GEO-85-TC002 — Competitive view handles fewer than five competitors
steps: Given fewer than five competitors are available for the market
When the competitive questions are displayed
Then the available competitors are shown without breaking the page

results.name: GEO-85-TC003 — AC1 Enrichment Trigger Consumption
steps: When geo-analysis-processor consumes the trigger
And a progress event is published at 40% with message "Visibility enrichment starting..."
Then Enrichment Trigger Consumption is applied successfully

results.name: GEO-85-TC004 — AC3 Brand Matching — AI Normalization
steps: Given enriched visibility responses with mentioned_entities
When brand matching runs
Then Step 1: text similarity pre-normalization groups obvious variants (case-insensitive, abbreviation, suffix — e.g., "BMW" = "bmw" = "BMW Group")
Then Step 2: Gemini AI call groups remaining brand families with domain hints (e.g., "Audi RS" → normalized_name: "Audi", "Tesla Model 3" → normalized_name: "Tesla")

results.name: GEO-84-TC001 — Perception trigger starts enrichment
steps: Given the pipeline receives a PERCEPTION_COMPLETE trigger
When the enrichment consumer handles the trigger
Then perception enrichment runs for the active market-category scopes

results.name: GEO-84-TC002 — Concepts are stored with response mapping
steps: Given perception responses are available for a market-category scope
When Gemini extracts concepts from the responses
Then the concepts are stored with response_ids and quote details

results.name: GEO-84-TC003 — Perception enrichment handles edge cases
steps: Given a perception scope has zero responses or a duplicate trigger arrives
When the pipeline processes the scope again
Then zero-response scopes are skipped and duplicate triggers do not create duplicate results

results.name: GEO-84-TC004 — AC4 Stored vs Computed Fields
steps: And concept.name — short concept name (2-4 words)
And concept.sentiment_score — derived from quotes (PM formula)
And concept.quotes[] — each with text, source_url, sentiment_score
And the following fields are NOT stored (computed at query time by dashboard, Epics 4-5):
And concept.frequency = response_ids.length / total_filtered_responses (changes with filter)
And concept.sentiment label = derived from sentiment_score (PM thresholds)
And response.sentiment = aggregated from concepts' scores (PM formula)
Then Stored vs Computed Fields is applied successfully

results.name: GEO-82-TC001 — 8 improvement types detected across 3 dimensions
steps: When the pipeline runs the improvement detection

Then 8 improvement types are detected across 3 dimensions: Visibility (low_visibility, poor_position, category_market_low, owned_media_gap), Competitive (low_favorability, category_market_losing, low_source_favorability), Reputation (negative_sentiment), each detected per LLM per category with severity (Critical < 25%, Warning < 40%, Info < 50%)

results.name: GEO-82-TC002 — Results stored in PostgreSQL (pre-computed)
steps: Given detection complete
When results are persisted
Then results are stored in PostgreSQL (pre-computed, not on dashboard load) and Priority Source Targets are computed per improvement area
